headline: Former Officer Accuses Military Police Colonel Of Physical Assault
seoTitle: Former Officer Alleges Assault By Military Police Colonel
metaDescription: A former military police officer has accused a colonel of physical assault following the discovery of a list containing names of women.
aiSummaryBullets: A former military police officer alleges she was assaulted by a police colonel.
The incident reportedly followed the discovery of a list containing 14 women's names in the colonel's personal records.
The document purportedly categorized women based on age and parental history, including the accuser's own name.
aiContextParagraph: A former member of the military police, identified as Camila Veneziani, has filed allegations of assault against Colonel Victor de Freitas Carvalho. According to reports, the conflict arose after Veneziani discovered a list within her then-partner's personal schedule. The document reportedly contained a table listing 14 women, including Veneziani, alongside details regarding their ages and information about their children. Beside these personal details, the list allegedly featured positive and negative indicators, which Veneziani described as an evaluation of women with whom the colonel was currently involved or intended to initiate relationships. The situation is currently under public scrutiny as investigations into the alleged conduct and the existence of the document continue following the initial report published in Folha de S.Paulo. No further details regarding the legal status or the colonel's response to the allegations have been disclosed at this time.
